name: Andazeh Measurement Price Calculator
author: Hamidreza Moghaddam

sections.description:
Andazeh (Persian for “measure”) lets customers type the amount they need – 2.5 metres of fabric, 12 m² of flooring, 3 kg of coffee – and calculates the price on the product page while they type.

Rules for many products at once: create a rule once and apply it to product categories (including sub-categories), tags, specific products or the whole shop. Every product can also have its own settings or switch the calculator off.

Features

  • Units for length, area, volume, weight and count, or your own unit name (roll, sheet, …).
  • One field for the amount, or length × width (area) and length × width × height (volume).
  • Price per unit set in the rule, or taken from the product and its variations.
  • Regular and sale price per unit, and a minimum price per item.
  • Pricing table: a different price per unit depending on the amount.
  • Minimum, maximum, step and default amount, checked in the browser and in the cart.
  • Live total price under the field, shown with or without tax like the rest of your shop.
  • Prices in the shop show the unit, e.g. “1,150,000 per m”.
  • Stock counted in the unit (30 in stock = 30 m); orders, cancellations and refunds change it by the amount bought. Decimal stock amounts are supported.
  • Shipping weight is multiplied by the amount, so weight-based shipping rates stay correct.
  • “Sold individually” for one line per product.
  • Works with simple and variable products, the classic cart and checkout and the cart and checkout blocks.
  • The amount is shown in the cart, checkout, orders and emails, and “Order again” keeps it.
  • Export and import rules as JSON.
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Ready for translation.

Moving from Flexible Quantity

Andazeh can import the templates of the Flexible Quantity – Measurement Price Calculator plugin (products, categories, tags, unit, price, limits, step, stock and pricing table). While Flexible Quantity is active, Andazeh waits and changes nothing, so you can import and check everything first. When you deactivate Flexible Quantity, Andazeh takes over immediately; carts and orders created with Flexible Quantity keep their amounts, and cancelling or refunding those orders returns the right amount to stock.

Flexible Quantity is a trademark of its respective owner. Andazeh is an independent plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by it.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Measurement prices and add a rule, or open a product and use its “Measurement” tab.
  3. Coming from Flexible Quantity? Use WooCommerce > Measurement prices > Import / export, check the rules, then deactivate Flexible Quantity.
sections.faq:
How is the price calculated?

Price per unit × entered amount. With a pricing table, the range containing the amount sets the price per unit. A minimum price, if set, is charged when the result is lower.

Which rule is used when several match?

The product’s own settings come first. Otherwise the enabled rule with the lowest priority number that matches the product is used.

What happens to the stock?

If “Stock is counted in this unit” is on, the product’s stock is a number of units (for example metres) and each order reduces it by the amount bought. Otherwise each item reduces the stock by one, as usual.

Can customers add measured products from the shop page?

No. The shop button opens the product page, where the amount is entered.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Improved: on variable products the calculator is shown above the quantity and add-to-cart button (on its own line), as in Flexible Quantity, so themes with a one-row quantity/button layout display it correctly.

1.0.2

  • Fix: “Sold individually” of a rule applies to the product, not to its variations, as in Flexible Quantity, so customers can still choose a quantity of a variation.

1.0.1

  • New: a category rule can apply to sub-categories or only to products directly in the chosen categories.
  • Fix: rules imported from Flexible Quantity now match products exactly as Flexible Quantity did (only the directly assigned categories, newest template first).
  • New: “The weight is the entered amount” shipping weight option for weight units (kg, g, …); used automatically for imported weight templates, as in Flexible Quantity.
  • Improved: the field starts at the minimum amount when no default is set.
  • Improved: “Sold individually” of a rule now also switches it off for measured products, as in Flexible Quantity.
  • Improved: whole-number check also when quantities are changed in the cart; products priced only by a pricing table are purchasable.

1.0.0

  • First release.

short_description: Sell WooCommerce products by length, area, volume, weight or any unit. Price, weight and stock follow the amount the customer enters.
